# BOXES Framework

## 1. B - Brain (Strategy Box)
This is the first box which represents the brain for the idea, this is the strategy box.

- **Real & Painful Pain Point**: Identify the real pain point, or problem we are trying to solve
- **Clear Customer Persona**: Who will be using the solution we are presenting
- **Distinct Competetive Edge**: That we are providing
- **Supporting Trend (AI / Rising Market)**: How to use AI or new trends in the solution
- **Prelimnary Business Model**: Building a business model to enable and simplify the solution

### Prupose
The goal from this box is to take a clear, and informed decision before starting building the solutiuon. To confirm that the idea is feasable and worth buidling a product before spending time, effort, and money.

### Outcome
- Confirm that there is a real effective problem
- Precisely define the client who is able to pay for it
- Confirm that the market is active and there is a real demand
- Define a clear and different competetive advantage
- Test the feasibility and enablement of making money

### Tools
- ChatGpt, Gemini, qwen
- Gamma app
- Google trends

## 2. O - Origin (Brand & Identity Box)
This box represent the branding and identity of the product. 

- **Clear & Catchy Name**
- **Compelling Brand Story**
- **Vision, Mission & Values**
- **Consistent Tone of Voice**
- **Simple Brand Book**

### Purpose
Building a clear identity for the product before releasing it to the market. Converting the idea from only a technical solution to an entity with personality and message. 

### Outcome
- Choose a clear easy-to-remember name
- Create a percise definitive statement showing the product value
- Define a clear product vision and mission
- Build a fixed persona and identity for the trademark
- Define a unified voice tone in all channels
- Build a simple identity guide for future use

### Tools
- ChatGpt, Gemini, qwen
- Dynadot, name.com, godaddy, namecheap

## 3. X - eXperience (Design Box)
Build a clear design and business flow suitable for the product

- **Logo**
- **Colors & Fonts**
- **Visual Style**
- **Initial UI/UX**
- **Testable Prototype**

### Purpose
Design a clear and simple user experience that can be tested in a few days. Convert the identity to an interface and a real experience with a result that can be seen by a user in the first minute.

### Outcome
- Define the first screen where the user can see the product value
- Simplify user journey to a 3 steps maximum
- Define the main moment (Core Action) inside the product
- Design a clear interface without noise
- Build a testable prototype for 5 users
- Confirm that the user understands the product in 30 seconds

### Tools
- ChatGpt, Gemini, qwen
- [Stitch](https://stitch.withgoogle.com): AI generated product screens.
- [Figma Make](https://www.figma.com/make)
- [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com)
- [uBrand](https://ubrand.com): AI generated business cards, powerpoint templates, etc...
- [BrandMark](https://brandmark.io): AI created Logos.
- [Z.ai](https://chat.z.ai): AI powerpoint presentations.
- [Napkin](https://www.napkin.ai): Generate any text to infographics with AI.
- [KIMI](https://www.kimi.com): AI powerpoint presentations.
- [Gamma app](https://gamma.app): AI powerpoint presentations.

## 4. E - Engine (Product Box)

- **Define Core Features**
- **Clear MVP**
- **Real User Test**
- **Truly Usable Experience**
- **Integrated AI**

### Purpose
Produce a working product (MVP) can be really used, without complex technicality or building a complete system from scratch. Converting the idea from a prototype into a real tool which is functioning and providing a clear value.

### Outcome
- Determine the main benefit (Core Feature) only
- Building a working (MVP) end to end
- Integrating AI into the main feature
- Testing the prodcut with real users
- Measurment of the first result or real interaction
- Releasing a first version which can be used and not only for demo

### Tools
- ChatGpt, Gemini, qwen
- GitHub Copilot
- [Google AI Studio](https://aistudio.google.com)
- [Replit](https://replit.com)
- [Lovable](https://lovable.dev)
- [Google Anaytics](https://analytics.google.com/)
- [Microsoft Clarity](https://clarity.microsoft.com)
- [Google Search](https://www.google.com)
